messages:
Maya Patel: Hey team — customer AcmePayments reports a ~30% higher token charge on their last invoice vs dashboard for streaming chat sessions. They suspect reconnects / partial gens are being double-counted. Attached invoice id: INV-2025-9843, stream example id: s_7a1f2c.

Kevin Liu: thanks Maya. quick questions: which model/version, SDK version, and are they using SSE or websocket streaming?

Maya Patel: SSE via our JS SDK v1.14.3. Model is rw-instruct-2.1. They do a client cancel + immediate reconnect in their UI (mobile) when network flaps.

Sam Ortiz: this pattern can produce split chunks: partial tokens recorded on first connection, then reconnec marks new session tokens — needs dedupe. do we currently append partial token counts on reconnect? :thinking:

SRE Oncall: tagging logs for s_7a1f2c now. can you paste a minimal repro or code snippet Maya?

Maya Patel: reproduction steps from customer (short):
1) Start SSE stream for chat completion.
2) Receive 1 sentence (~45 tokens) then connection drops.
3) Client immediately reconnects and resumes; server sends next tokens from a new slice.
4) Dashboard shows 45 tokens for first session + 200 tokens for resumed session, invoice counts the 45 + 200 = 245 but customer expected ~200 because they think first 45 were retransmitted.

Maya Patel: sample client (simplified):
```
const evt = new EventSource('/v1/chat/stream?session=s_7a1f2c');
evt.onmessage = (e) => append(e.data);
evt.onerror = () => { evt.close(); // reconnect immediately }
// reconnect code runs with same session id
```

Kevin Liu: from runtime side, we log token windows per connection id, not per logical session id. if they reuse session id we still treat as new connection. that could cause double-counting. but billing pipeline should dedupe contiguous partials with same session id within X seconds — need to verify if that dedupe window expired.

BillingBot: Auto-note: Invoice INV-2025-9843 queued for manual review. Reference: s_7a1f2c.

Sam Ortiz: SRE can you check ingestion event for s_7a1f2c around 2025-06-12T14:02:18Z — look for events: connection.open, chunk.emit, connection.close, connection.open. Also check token offsets (start_token_idx / end_token_idx) to see overlap.

SRE Oncall: pulled logs — two connections 14:02:18Z and 14:02:19Z, both reported chunks. I see overlapping token ranges: connA ended at token 45, connB started at token 43 (rewind 2 tokens). That overlap would cause double-counting unless dedupe merged overlapping ranges.

Zara Chen: if overlap exists and dedupe window <=1s we may have missed merge because client reconnect was at ~900ms and dedupe window was 500ms for SSE. currently config: billing.dedupe.window_ms=500.

Kevin Liu: ok that explains under/over depending on overlap. Proposed short-term fix: increase dedupe.window_ms to 1500ms for streaming sessions and log metrics (overlap_count, overlap_token_avg). Longer term: make dedupe operate on token indexes per session id rather than connection boundaries.

Maya Patel: customer asks for quick remediation and possible refund for the overbilled tokens. can billing ops run an adjust if overlap tokens > 30 and invoice delta > $50?

BillingBot: Action required: create manual billing adjustment request #ADJ-4772. Attaching logs and overlap summary.

Sam Ortiz: also note a potential client workaround: on reconnect send header `X-Redwood-Resume-From: <last_token_idx>` so server can avoid resending overlap and make server-side dedupe more reliable. recommend adding to SDK docs.

SRE Oncall: created internal ticket RINF-1623 to extend dedupe window and add overlap metrics. will run a backfill script to compute per-session merged token counts for open invoices in last 30 days. ETA: 24h for backfill, 72h for config roll.

Maya Patel: thanks everyone — I'll update AcmePayments that we have a ticket, manual adjustment pending, and a doc/workaround for SDK. :thumbsup:

Kevin Liu: follow-up for eng-ml/eng-runtime: can we add idempotent resume token in protocol and log `resume_token` in billing events? that'll make reconciliation trivial.

Sam Ortiz: agreed. filing request to runtime: RINF-1624 (protocol resume token)

Maya Patel: closing loop: customer wants timeline + what we changed. I'll draft an email after the manual adj or if backfill completes.

SRE Oncall: marking thread with :eyes: and will post updates here as tasks progress.

BillingBot: Update: ADJ-4772 created and queued for review by billing-ops.

Kevin Liu: nice — and let's add a quick test to our e2e to simulate reconnects at different latencies to validate dedupe window.

Maya Patel: noted. will coordinate with QA.
